0022600212.text: The 76ers (9-2, 8-2 in their last ten, 1st in the Atlantic) host the Celtics (7-2, 7-2 in their last ten, one game behind Philadelphia in the Atlantic), with Boston having one more game to play before this one and Philadelphia currently on a one-game winning streak. Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2 and the 76ers winning their 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, with the most recent meeting a 109-100 Philadelphia win in Boston on May 2, 2026.
